item.title: Drive Radio — August 6, 2026
item.description: - Changes at Google DeepMind: Hassabis to Chair, Jeff Dean departs: A surprising leadership shakeup at the peak of Google's AI momentum raises questions about what's really happening behind the scenes. (https://blog.google/company-news/inside-google/message-ceo/next-chapter-ai-momentum/) - DeepSeek planning to significantly raise prices: The AI disruptor famous for dirt-cheap models is about to prove that cheap AI was never actually free. (https://platform.deepseek.com/usage) - Humans missed 1 in 3 threats approving AI agent commands across 40k game runs: A wild new stat shows human oversight of AI agents might be more theater than safety net. (https://scalex.dev/blog/ai-agent-permissions-stats/) - Discovery Loop: The addictive new curiosity rabbit-hole site that ate Hacker News' entire day. (https://www.discoveryloop.com/) - Crime Pays but Botany Doesn't: A botanist's reading list on why plant science gets no love became an unlikely hit — and a metaphor for underfunded, unglamorous work everywhere. (https://www.crimepaysbutbotanydoesnt.com/reading-list)

item.title: Drive Radio — August 7, 2026
item.description: - New Orleans is testing Carbyne's AI-powered Emergency Call Triage software: AI is now deciding how your 911 call gets prioritized — dispatchers say it's a staffing cut in disguise. (https://www.shreveporttimes.com/story/news/local/louisiana/2026/07/28/is-new-orleans-using-ai-to-answer-911-calls-instead-of-human-dispatchers-impacts-emergencies-crime/91065014007/) - AMD acquires Taalas to boost inference performance by etching models in silicon: AMD is literally hardcoding AI models into chips — permanent, blazing fast, and impossible to update. (https://www.theregister.com/systems/2026/08/06/amd-acquires-ai-chip-startup-taalas-to-boost-inference-performance-by-etching-models-into-silicon/5284344) - GitHub Actions and Pages are experiencing degraded availability: A reminder that half the internet's software plumbing runs through one company's status page. (https://www.githubstatus.com/incidents/qcvjkzcs7j74) - Framework discloses data breach via Metabase 0-day: Even the right-to-repair darling of laptops got breached — through a boring internal analytics tool. (https://community.frame.work/t/framework-data-breach-discussion/83939) - Meta Ordered to Pay $942M to Address Harm to Kids from Social Media: Nearly a billion-dollar order could be the opening crack in how courts hold platforms accountable for teen mental health. (https://www.wsj.com/tech/meta-ordered-to-pay-942-million-to-address-harm-to-kids-from-social-media-8ba5aab7) - Bioengineered chewing gum may offer a way to fight HPV and other microbes: Scientists engineered gum that traps and neutralizes viruses right where many of them start — in your mouth. (https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/08/260803080917.htm)
